definitions.receiver_s: wire parse + subtract + PRNG seed + decode + canonical output normalization
definitions.full_decode_s: sender + transfer + receiver, original formal-v1 figure boundary
definitions.uncertainty: 10,000 cluster bootstrap resamples; first average three repeats per dataset; do not count repeats as independent inputs
definitions.paired_speedup: IBLT/XYZ means on original common datasets (42 matched dataset pairs in total)
definitions.v10_speedup: old GF v10 / v15 means on identical original five XYZ timing datasets; separate run epochs

protocol.purpose: final frozen XYZ v15 evaluation, main and existing parameter timing; stop development after completion
protocol.input_policy: original five selected successful timing inputs for each original configuration, original seeds, no new success-dependent reselection; preserve failures without replacement

measure_boundaries.update: two set-maintenance windows divided by 20000000 input elements
measure_boundaries.receiver: wire parse + subtract + PRNG seed + decode + output normalization, all original validation inside timer
measure_boundaries.full_decode: sender + transfer + receiver, original paper comparison definition
measure_boundaries.transfer: in-memory message copy, no network waiting

protocol.analysis: average three repetitions per original dataset, then average five dataset means; 10000 cluster bootstrap resamples; pair methods only on common original input datasets
protocol.reuse: original M/k/ell/a/z, threshold tables, ideal-cell heatmaps, parameter choices, existing reliability cohorts; unchanged non-IBLT baselines retain original sources; no new calibration or reliability sweep
protocol.completion_policy: deliver frozen code/version, every raw run including failures, summary and confidence intervals, final figures and author report; no further optimization
